issues.title: Your phone number is missing from the hidden business data Google reads on 16 pages
issues.found: No phone number in the page's business data (LegalService schema)
issues.why: Behind each page is hidden code (called schema or structured data) that tells Google who the business is. Without your phone number there, Google has to guess it from the page text.
issues.fix: Add the phone number to the LegalService block in each page's code.

issues.fix: Add one LegalService block with the official name, phone, address and website to the home page.

issues.title: The “Save our contact” file doesn’t match your official details: the name reads “Law Offices of Corey Pingle” instead of “Law Offices of Corey A. Pingle”; there is no address; the website is https://pinglelaw.com instead of https://www.pinglelaw.com
issues.found: the name reads “Law Offices of Corey Pingle” instead of “Law Offices of Corey A. Pingle”; there is no address; the website is https://pinglelaw.com instead of https://www.pinglelaw.com
issues.expected: Law Offices of Corey A. Pingle, (714) 593-2306, 9550 Warner Ave #250-06, Fountain Valley, CA 92708, https://www.pinglelaw.com
issues.why: When someone taps “Save contact”, their phone stores these details. If they’re wrong or incomplete, that’s what customers see and share.
issues.fix: Update the contact file (pingle-law-contact.vcf) so it has the official name, phone, address and website.

issues.title: Your address is shown on only 2 pages
issues.why: Search engines trust a business more when its address appears consistently, such as in the footer.
issues.fix: Add the address to the footer of every page if you want it public everywhere. Skip this if you prefer to show it only on the contact page.
